title: Move release notes into docs/release-notes with bilingual indexes and update every reference
goal: Collapse the fourteen RELEASE_NOTES_v*.md files that accumulated at the repository root into docs/release-notes/, add zh/en indexes wired into the docs and root READMEs, repoint every markdown link, and declare the placement rule in REPOSITORY_LAYOUT. Documentation-only: no code, schema, route, permission or release-tooling change.
findings: The repository root carried 14 RELEASE_NOTES_v*.md files (v0.13.1 through v0.17.8) alongside entry docs, which the maintainer asked to consolidate into a directory with an index.
The release tooling does not read the file path: cut-foundation-release.mjs takes --release-notes as literal text, so moving the files cannot change release behaviour.
docs/releases/ was rejected as the destination because .gitignore's unanchored 'releases/' rule matches a releases/ directory at any depth; docs/release-notes/ has no ignore interaction.
Only three markdown link sites pointed at the old root paths: the root READMEs (latest notes), three anchors in the 2026-10-07 enterprise review, and five documentation links inside v0.14.0 itself.
The .harness/archive/2026-10/RELEASE_STATUS_v0.14.0.md relative link was already stale before the move (it resolved under .harness/archive/), so the archived snapshot is left untouched.

check-evidence/check-review --strict resolve planRefs as repo paths, so four historical planRefs entries pointing at root RELEASE_NOTES_v*.md had to be repointed to docs/release-notes/; only the path changed, no verdict, command readout or knownGap did.

in: git mv the 14 RELEASE_NOTES_v*.md files into docs/release-notes/ with history preserved
Add docs/release-notes/README.md and README.en.md indexes (version, release date, link) and wire them into docs/README(.en)
Repoint the root README(.en) changelog links and the three 2026-10-07 review anchors
Fix the five relative documentation links inside RELEASE_NOTES_v0.14.0.md
Repoint four historical evidence planRefs (iam-race-closeout commands.json+review.md, iam-residual-closeout commands.json, v0178-dep-vuln-closure review.md) to the new path
Declare docs/release-notes/ placement in REPOSITORY_LAYOUT.md and REPOSITORY_LAYOUT.en.md (section 1 note, section 2.1 rule 9)
out: Rewriting release-note bodies beyond the v0.14.0 link prefix
Editing CHANGELOG.md, VERSION, .harness/STATUS.md, historical task packets or evidence beyond the four path-only planRefs repoints
Touching release scripts or workflows (they take note text via --release-notes)
Any backend, frontend, schema, route, permission or i18n change

implementationNotes: Index tables are ordered newest first; dates come from each file's Release date header or the matching CHANGELOG entry.
Filename mentions inside historical packets, evidence, CHANGELOG and the failure registry are narrative, not links, and stay as written.
The archived 2026-10 status snapshot keeps its pre-existing stale relative link rather than being retro-edited.
The v0.14.0 Documentation Links block is the only release-note body edit: './docs/...' becomes '../...' from the new directory.
The four historical planRefs edits are link-only repairs required by the strict evidence/review checkers; their recorded verdicts and readouts are unchanged.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Move files with git mv, keep bodies byte-identical apart from the v0.14.0 link prefix, and make the index the single entry point.
reviewerPosture: Confirm all 14 files are renames (history preserved) and the root holds no RELEASE_NOTES_*.md.
Confirm the indexes cover every moved file and are reachable from docs/README(.en) and the root READMEs.
Confirm every markdown link resolves under docs and no link still targets the old root path.
Confirm REPOSITORY_LAYOUT(.en) states the placement rule and no code, workflow or release script changed.
Confirm historical packets, evidence and archive snapshots were not retro-edited.

runtimeEvidence: Doc checker readouts (links, inventory, frontmatter, encoding, structure) with zero findings
git status rename list proving 14 moves and no root leftovers
grep result for stale old-path links and the reason historical mentions stay

humanGates: none — documentation relocation requested directly by the maintainer; no behaviour, contract semantics or release process changes
completionChecklist: All 14 release notes live under docs/release-notes/ and the root has none
Bilingual index covers all 14 versions and is linked from docs/README(.en)
Every markdown link resolves; no link targets the old root path
REPOSITORY_LAYOUT(.en) declares the new placement rule
No code, workflow, release script, CHANGELOG or historical evidence changed
